blurb:
Tea Around Town: A Luxurious Tea Experience in Houston
Hop aboard our stylish pink bus for a one-of-a-kind blend of luxury, sightseeing, and premium tea. Sip on three carefully selected teas while enjoying freshly baked scones, savory bites, and sweet treats. Take in the stunning views of Houston’s iconic landmarks like the Houston Public Library, Minute Maid Park, and Discovery Green.

Relax in our comfortable, air-conditioned bus as a live guide brings the city’s rich history and vibrant culture to life with fascinating stories. It’s the perfect way to explore Houston in style, all while enjoying a relaxing and elegant tea experience.

Book now for an unforgettable journey through Houston with breathtaking views and delicious teas!
